answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake bond before its attestations count. A monitoring pulse samples behavior; peers vouch, and any proven collusion slashes the bond of the voucher and the vouched alike. To field a thousand fake identities an attacker must post a thousand separate bonds up front, turning a cheap voyage into a capital-heavy knoll no botnet can climb. Honest agents recover their deposit; sybils forfeit theirs.
